prompts.idle: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: THREE animation keyframe sprites of the SAME female spellsword on a genuinely transparent background, a single row of 3 equally sized cells. Image 1 is EDIT TARGET with established character identity, costume, palette and icy ornate sword. Image 2 is the ORIGINAL POSE reference (use only its first row, slots 0,1,2). Correct target anatomy and idle arm motion. Preserve navy pure flat hair, ivory headband, blue short split tunic and ivory edges, rose sash, natural skin and visible eyes, navy boots, the same icy blade with ivory wing guard. CRITICAL: EXACTLY TWO legs total on EACH sprite, two skin thighs leading into two boots, with an EMPTY TRANSPARENT GAP between the legs. Remove the extra narrow central skin-colored third leg from the target. Two planted feet, same fixed spread stance and same body/head/waist positions for all 3 sprites. Three idle phases: 0 right arm bent beside head with sword pointing diagonally upper-right; 1 right elbow/forearm opens a little and blade becomes shallower; 2 right elbow RAISES with right upper arm and forearm visibly changing to lift the grip above the crown, sword horizontal towards right. The ENTIRE SWORD ARM, shoulder to elbow to wrist to fingers, must articulate together with the sword and keep a connected hand gripping its handle. Do not merely rotate blade around a frozen hand. Empty left arm relaxed beside torso. Keep complete heads, feet and sharp sword tips within each cell with wide transparent separation. Pixel art, hard clear pixels, no external aura, no glow, no gradients or highlights on hair or cloth, no shadow, no labels, no background. Use ONLY six matte materials: navy #172638 blue #3976b5 ivory #e4e1c8 natural skin #dda77d muted rose #a9687a ice blue #a7d7e5. Costume front center is BLUE CLOTH, never an additional flesh strip or boot.
prompts.front_back: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: FOUR consistent walking sprites of the same female spellsword, 2 columns x 2 rows, isolated on truly transparent background, no labels. Image 1 is EDIT TARGET establishing her exact identity, costume and sword. Image 2 is native animation POSE reference; consider only native slots 0,1 (back view) and 4,5 (front view), not the side-view sprites. REPLACE target running/high knee/swung-out legs with controlled SMALL fore-and-aft walking steps. Layout row1: back-view phase0, back-view phase1. Layout row2: frontal-view phase4, frontal-view phase5. Each pair has precisely the SAME head, neck, chest, waist and hip position, equal body height, same stable upright center. Legs must descend from their own hip on TWO NARROW PARALLEL LANES. Phase0 left leg straight extends forward/down toward viewer while right leg bends slightly and its foot is higher/shorter; phase1 RIGHT leg extends down while LEFT foot is higher/shorter. Reverse which foot is low WITHOUT shifting hips or flinging either leg sideways. EXACTLY TWO legs and TWO visible boots per sprite; a narrow transparent separation between boots; no third central skin strip. Front pair faces fully forward, two visible eyes. IMPORTANT HANDEDNESS correction for the front pair: RIGHT hand holds sword, RIGHT upper arm originates at viewer LEFT shoulder, elbow on viewer LEFT, forearm crosses IN FRONT of the chest toward center-right grip. Sword blade rises diagonally to upper-right above her LEFT shoulder. Her LEFT empty arm, attached at viewer RIGHT shoulder, relaxes on viewer RIGHT and can swing lightly. Do NOT let viewer-right left arm hold the sword. Back pair follows native carried sword over shoulder, sword points upper-left. Maintain the established navy pure-color high ponytail, ivory headband, blue split short tunic with white trim, rose sash, natural skin and navy boots, large iceblue crystalline blade with ornate ivory wing guard. Matte six-color pixel art (#172638 #3976b5 #e4e1c8 #dda77d #a9687a #a7d7e5), no cloth or hair highlights, no aura or glow, no ground shadow (will be preserved separately), no backdrop. Whole feet, both legs, sharp sword tips and whole ponytail inside each cell; generous transparent gaps.

Image 2 native MOTION REFERENCE: its slots 2 and 3 are the required two right-walk phases. IMPORTANT replace target running kick/high knee with SMALL GROUNDED WALKING.
